text:
Samir: heads-up — we started seeing a spike in failed JIT assigns around 07:04 UTC. users w/ no email claim are getting no-roles.
Jess: saw that, one user reported they were denied access to the staging dashboard. any pattern on which attr is missing?
Samir: SAML assertions missing `email`. they have `eduPersonPrincipalName` and `employeeNumber`. our role-mapper expects primaryEmail first.
Okta-Bot: authz.log 2140001210: WARNING user=urn:okta:abcd1234 missing_attr=email skip_role_mapping=true
Marcos: that log line matches. we should be falling back to eppn, but looks like fallback ordering got reordered in the 2026-03-15 deploy.
Laura: rollback candidate? how widespread is impact?
Samir: ~120 failed JITs in last hour, mostly contractors and some service accounts created via SCIM with no email. no admin escalation seen.
Mike: quick mitigation — can we add a temporary mapping on the identity side? map eppn -> email in Okta transform for the SAML assertion. low-risk and reversible.
Jess: agree. also we need to ensure audit logs capture which attribute was used for the mapping so we can triage properly. current logs just say "used primaryEmail" or "skipped".
Marcos: minimal change from service side: role-mapper could accept an ordered list of identifiers instead of hard requiring email. patch ready:
```
diff --git a/role-mapper/config.yaml b/role-mapper/config.yaml
@@
- principal: [primaryEmail]
+ principal: [primaryEmail, eduPersonPrincipalName, employeeNumber]
```

Marcos: PR #3482 tests green locally. would like a canary to prod.
Laura: okta transform is faster — I'll push a temporary attribute transform and notify IT. do we need KMS or key-change coordination?
Samir: no key changes needed for transform. but note: when we log the assertion payload for debugging, strip PII and encrypt at rest with KMS. current debug dumps are visible in the support bucket.
Mike: opened ticket ENGOPS-2394 to rotate debug retention and enable envelope encryption. tagging security-oncall.
Okta-Bot: deploy pipeline: transform-change -> okta-tenant/staging -> complete (07:21 UTC).
Jess: after transform push we saw successful JIT for two previously failing users. need to verify for all SCIM-created users.
Marcos: starting canary of role-mapper PR to 5% traffic now. monitor dashboards: jita.assign.failure_rate, authz.latency.
Samir: monitoring: failure_rate dropped from 0.9% -> 0.12% during canary window. looks good.
Laura: follow-up items: 1) permanent change to role-mapper config (Marcos PR) 2) add attribute-fallback audit field (who used which attr) 3) clean up debug SAML dumps + enable KMS envelope keys (ENGOPS-2394).
Mike: assigning ENGOPS-2394 to me. will update runbook and set retention to 30d encrypted.
Jess: also adding an integration test for SAML payloads with email missing -> expect eppn fallback and correct role.
Samir: thanks. after merge let's schedule a quick postmortem note in incidents and tag any customers who reported failures. :thumbsup:
Mike: noted, prepping PM brief.
Marcos: PR merged to main at 07:49 UTC, will promote to prod after 1h of canary.
Okta-Bot: notify: incident channel updated with summary link — https://redwood.internal/incidents/2140001234
Jess: good catch team, low blast radius and quick fix. will follow-up with verification script for SCIM imports.
Samir: closing loop once ENGOPS-2394 and the audit-field PR are live. thanks folks."
